metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.6 · 1970 · Airport
metas.description: A bomber on board an airplane, an airport almost closed by snow, and various personal problems of the people involved.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.8 · 1974 · Airport 1975
metas.description: A 747 in flight collides with a small plane, and is rendered pilotless. Somehow the control tower must get a pilot aboard so the jet can land.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.8 · 1977 · Airport '77
metas.description: Art thieves hijack a 747, hit fog and crash into the ocean, trapping them and the passengers under one hundred feet of water.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.5 · 1979 · The Concorde... Airport '79
metas.description: A supersonic airborne disaster. In order to survive a flight headed for the Moscow Olympics, passengers of the Concorde must endure aerial acrobatics to dodge missiles and survive a device that decompresses the plane.
